usageNotes: Use this to inspect the ordered ruleset of a specific cluster-level security group before modifying or auditing firewall policy. The group name must already exist (use list_cluster_firewall_groups to verify); the name is case-sensitive and follows the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+. Rules are returned in positional order (pos field); disabled rules (enable: 0) are included in the list and must be filtered client-side if only active rules are needed.

examples.summary: List all rules in the 'web-tier' security group

tips: The pos field is the rule's index (0-based or 1-based depending on PVE version) and is used as the child link for fetching or modifying individual rules.
Rules with enable=0 are still returned; check this field before assuming all returned rules are active.
Security groups referenced inside another group's rules appear as action values (not ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT), so you may see nested group names in the action field.
Requires Sys.Audit privilege on the root path (/); API tokens must have this privilege explicitly granted.
